reviews.text: Dr. Chew is an amazing doctor.  He's great with pets. The staff are very friendly and helpful.
Best in the business.

Very unprofessional and borderline rude the way the vet spoke to us. Didnt even bother getting our dog’s gender correctly and went straight to criticizing the way we parent our puppy when we asked a question. Our appointment was at the end of the day, the vet was clearly trying to rush us out. This is the third poor experience Ive had with this place. Gave it the benefit of the doubt the first two times.

I love Petcare. I love the staff, I love their policies, I love their reasonable pricing, I love Dr. Chew, and I loved the older generation of Biedermans. I do not love the younger Dr. Biederman. I don't even like him. I avoid dealing with him whenever possible. That being said, I exclude him from the 5 stars because I've been bringing numerous dogs and cats to Petcare for probably close to 20 years and I recommend them very highly. Just not the new Dr. Biederman.

If I could give this awful place a zero rating, they would definitely deserve it. How can they play with the life of a pet that becomes the most important thing to you? It's truly outrageous that they only care about money. I was with my little baby because he couldn't defecate, and this so-called "doctor," who seems more like an animal killer than anything else, inserted a thermometer into his rectum without even using a protective bag and without gloves. He roughly checked his ears and told me there was nothing wrong with him, prescribing some medication that would supposedly make my kitten defecate. I went home feeling reassured, thinking he was a professional. Yesterday, I called to tell him my cat still hadn't defecated, and the woman who answered the phone told me I could come in before 3 pm. Immediately afterward, the so-called doctor called me back to say he couldn't do anything for my cat and that I should seek help at a hospital. After spending the entire afternoon and night at a 24-hour hospital, they told me that medication wasn't for that, and today, at a specialist's clinic, they told me that medication wasn't for that either. If you read these comments, please don't take your pets to this place. They only care about money and not your pet's health. After visiting them, my baby was very sick; he didn't want anything but to sleep and drink his bottle. Thank God I was able to save my little one's life.

Dr. Jonathan is amazing!!! Took both my cat babies Tara and Figaro to him and always met with exceptional service, knowledge and professionalism. He never fails to make you chuckle during every visit and I have so much assurance that my furbabies are in good hands. The clinic is a 4 minute drive away from my place, so convenient! 10/10 will recommend this practice and wishing continued success!!! It's no wonder you guys are the neighborhood's trusted animal clinic  <3

I had been bringing my cat to this practice since I adopted her at 8 months old. She was 6 years old when she passed away this January. Over the years, we always had great experiences with Dr. Jonathan.

On January 24, I brought my cat in because she was coughing. Dr. Jonathan was unavailable, so we saw Dr. Chew. We showed him videos of her coughing, but he assured us it was nothing serious. He gave her an antibiotic injection and medication and told us that if the coughing didn’t improve, then she would need an X-ray.

That same night at 2 a.m., I woke up to my cat screaming and struggling to breathe. We rushed her to the emergency vet, where she sadly passed away.

It took me a long time to write this review because I was so heartbroken. I understand that not every outcome can be prevented, but I can’t help wondering if more should have been done when we first brought her in. After trusting this practice with my cat’s care for over five years, this experience was devastating.
This is a lovely place how welcoming and friendly everyone is.
Hello, can the doctors here perform a spaying or neutering surgery on a cat?

Dr. Chew gives it to you straight and is considerate of your time and money. He won't tell you to have something done unless it's something he thinks necessary or that he would do for his own dog. I love his vibe and how sweet he is too my big buy (Biggie Smalls). The staff is polite and knowledgeable and I've never had an issue making appointments.

Dr. Chew was great, he was very kind and understanding. I felt very welcomed at the office and the front desk was very informative and friendly. Definitely will continue to come here, best vet visit for my cat in a long time.

Thank you guys for the great service and support.
It's been great since I discovered this animal clinic; my pet is super happy, eats, plays, and the care is top-notch.
Awesome experience with them. My male cat Jimmy got neutered here. They took care very well. Thanx a lot Doctor.
The service was excellent. The doctor explained my puppy's health very well and gave great suggestions. It's an excellent dog clinic; I highly recommend it.
Heard they give expired meds

Since I found this animal clinic back in the 80's, all of my dogs have gone here for excellent care. The Biederman brothers are wonderful, and now they have Dr. Ron, who is great too. Your companion animal is in good hands for yearly check-ups, surgeries, and general advice when needed. I live in Maspeth, but have been making the trip out here knowing that my dogs were always in the best of hands for their health and well-being. The staff is also great. A really great find for truly caring doctors for your companion animals.
Sadly, Dr. Jack Biederman is no longer here, and I miss his candor in discussing options for medical conditions and treatments. I wish I knew if he has left to begin his own practice elsewhere, or he has retired. I always trusted his opinions and advice.
I have gone back in time to read some reviews, and I am baffled by some. Of three dogs that I have had, two had to be euthanized (one died at home), and I was always allowed to stay with them in the room until I was ready to leave after they had passed. I was never rushed out. Any time a dog needed surgery which was not their particular forte, LIVS was recommended for the procedure. As I had stated earlier, I had great faith in their advice.

My dog Bentley went today for a regular check up and got his recommended yearly vaccines. The vet is very friendly and makes you feel comfortable. He also help me cut his nails that were very long. It was my first time here, I will definitely come back. The receptionists were awesome also. 👍😄 …
Super friendly and affordable prices
Been going there for years. The Biederman bros always took special care of my dogs and passed it down to same caring doctors. The staff is always welcoming and helpful.

Super clean clinic , thanks so much for giving my dog an appointment the same day! Love the staff super friendly.  You have a client that will definitely come from Canada to see you when we are in tow! Thanks' so much. I must recommend this clinic

I've been bringing my goldendoodle to Dr. Jonathan for almost 9 years and he is incredibly professional, easygoing, and knowledgable. My mom even came here with her pets back when the older 2 Biedermans were still practicing so we've trusted them for decades. It is easy to get appointments and the staff are kind. prices are extremely fair. It is evident how much they care for your pets and I will always recommend this practice to others.

Wonderful. Brought my two cats here for the first time because they had ringworm. They saw me the same day. Visit was quick and efficient. The vet explained everything simply and gave me multiple courses of action as options, explaining the likely effectiveness of each. They offered multiple types of treatment but didn't push me to buy anything. I don't even think they charged me anything besides the cost of the medications I bought. Will definitely be making this place my regular vet.

I’ve been bringing my pets here for years—first my dog (now 7) and now my new cat and I couldn’t be happier with the care they receive. The doctors are knowledgeable, attentive, and professional, and test results and medications are always delivered promptly. The front desk is also very attentive and very helpful. Highly recommend this clinic to any pet owner! Pro tip: if you’re visiting for a medical concern, bring a stool sample to save yourself an extra trip.
Good professional service 👍 …

Dr. Chew was great with helping me with my Cat Kida. When look at treatment options he gave me 3-4 choice in varying prices and was incredibly knowledgeable.

He is incredibly kind and will lay out all the options for you and let you pick. 10/10

After giving my cat a vaccination, I left pet care and back to my car and I noticed smoke coming out of my car. When I opened the door, I saw flames under the seat. I rushed inside to tell the front desk. The lady at the front desk was very nice and gave me two cups of water. I successfully put out the fire. Fearing it would flare up again, I went back to ask for two more cups of water, but the lady at the front desk told me that Dr. Jonathan Biederman told her  to not give water and I should call 911. Then Dr. Jonathan Biederman came out and said, "This is a veterinary clinic, not a fire station. We can't help you." I swear those were his exact words. I said, "I'm a client, not a stranger. I just want two cups of water. You talking like that makes me feel like I don't want to come back." He said he didn't care.
I found his logic strange. If it was just his car, with just a little bit flames .wouldn't he do anything until the fire truck arrived? Thankfully, I later discovered the fire was caused by a lighter in the car. No one was injured, and my car only had minor damage.
I believe we all need help. Be kind to others, and you'll receive help in return. Thanks again to the lady at the front desk. She's such a nice person.

Dr. Jonathan is extremely professional, attentive, considerate, friendly, and caring. The clinic is warm and comfortable, and the staff are like family, making you feel right at home. I highly recommend Dr. Jonathan for ensuring my fur baby, Lucky, receives the best possible care!
Very good, but I didn't like that they don't do your pet's things in front of you.

DISCLAIMER** TRUST is way more important to me than price when it comes to my little fur baby 😍** Having an intelligent, down to earth, transparent, and super kind doctor (Heyyyy Dr. Chew!) along with the accommodating and consistent admin staff makes PetCare Animal Clinic an easy first choice when it comes to my vet needs. I have been coming here since 2015 and will continue to do so for as long as I have pets. Highly recommend.

Highly unprofessional and would not recommend to friends and family. Doctor said the condition is very serious and asked to take to a hospital specialist which we end up waiting for more than 6 hours at the hospital, only to get charged 2k at the emergency for simple drug prescription and injection. Could have gone to any vet and get treated for simple constipated bowel without wasting all those time and money.
Dr. Chu is excellent doctor and prices r not bad.

Love Dr Chew and Dr Jonathan plus all the staff!
Always friendly and helpful.  Makes my life easier having a place I can trust my furbabies with
Very nice place, good worker's, they treat you professional they not killing you with the price, they appreciate you’re business. Very professional
Knowledgeable Vet and friendly  staff, easy parking

Dr Chew is a kind and patient vet. He has taken such good care of my dog Rocky for the past few years .He always answers phone calls and takes the time to clearly explain everything. We have been bringing our dog here for over 16 years and have never considered going anywhere else .

This review has been overdue. We've been coming here for my 2 babies ( both shih tzus ). They take a good care of them both. Dr Chew & the staffs are amazing & appreciate them a lot. They are all accommodating & they do care a lot to all animals the come to this clinic.
Always a good experience. Friendly staff. Great doctors. Good vibe all around.

I can't say enough about this place. A great staff that truly cares about the well being of your pet and also you.

We thank them for helping us with our beautiful Coco. She will forever be in our hearts. The kindness and compassion shared with us helped to keep us strong in some challenging times. Highly recommend this location.
Dr chu is honest and knowledgeable.
Brought my Doberman dog in staff was really friendly with him and the food was great ! Laura our waitress was very attentive with our dog. 10/10 pet friendly restaurant

terrible experience they wanted to charge me $800+ for a surgery my dog never needed, they i called multiple times to get records of my appointment and they kept trying to avoid me because i didn’t proceed to the surgery after i took him to his original veterinary i take him, just a scam to make money!!

Is a language barrier always your excuse to dismiss your customers’ concerns, Dr. Johnathon? I’m deeply disappointed with how you handled the communication regarding my dog’s dental procedure. It seems you’re always too busy to listen patiently and instead rush through every conversation.

I brought my dog to Petcare Animal Clinic for a dental procedure after clearly discussing with Dr. Johnathon that the treatment would include removing plaque, rotted teeth, and inflamed gum tissue. However, after the procedure, I realized that the inflamed gum tissue was not removed. When I called to clarify, Dr. Johnathon claimed it wasn’t specified on the paperwork and that I would need to sign additional forms for that. If this was the case, why wasn’t it explained to me beforehand? As a customer, I don’t know the ins and outs of your paperwork – it’s your responsibility to guide me through it. His dismissive response to my concern – “Why don’t you listen to yourself and see if you understand yourself?” – was unprofessional and disrespectful.

On top of this, no aftercare instructions, follow-up plans, or cautions were provided post-procedure. I had to ask about everything step by step, which should have been clearly communicated without prompting.

I expected a higher level of professionalism and care from Petcare Animal Clinic, but this experience left me feeling unheard and frustrated. I hope this feedback encourages better communication and customer care in the future

I took biggie there last week and today I’m goin to take Tupac there for his shots doctor chew is definitely a good dude that’s cares and it’s not about the money Times aren’t good for a lot of people and he’ll definitely help you with other options for kid pet and I did deal wit biederman One visit he was definitely nice and helpful biggies bin goin there since he’s born and his 3 now

Dr. Chew is truly such a wonderful vet and our Mochi was taken care of every single time we went and he always returned our calls. Only thing that prevents me from giving the clinic a 5 star rating is that they are very old school and don't …
Have been going here for years ! Awesome staff. Made every process of my dogs surgery smooth.

They're the best. The vets here are fantastic and deeply caring, they've taken good care of my cat for a variety of concerns and I felt happy and satisfied each time. My sister moved and felt sad that she wasn't going to find another vet like ours anywhere else, I forget his name but the guy with glasses is just wonderful.

I have been using this vet for ten years and wouldn't go anywhere else. Dr. Biederman always makes sure my cats are healthy and knows his stuff. I find the pricing reasonable and the office staff have helped me reschedule appointments with little fuss.

Nice and local. They always are able to help us out with an urgent appointment when our previous vet was booked up for weeks ahead. They really take the time to hear your concerns and do the best they can for your pet.
